case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Two accused, the appellant and her husband, are named and convicted.

accused_gender.reason: One accused is a woman and one is a man, so mixed is supported.

accused_age.reason: No age is stated for either accused.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Head Constable in the Punjab Police (husband, Ginder Singh)
accused_occupation.quote: Ginder Singh who was a Head Constable in the Punjab Police
accused_occupation.reason: The judgment states the husband's occupation, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

victim_gender.reason: Informant Angrej Singh is referred to with male pronoun 'him'.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the informant paid Rs.50,000/- to Ginder Singh at his quarter in the presence of his wife
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Spouse' describes the accused's relation to each other; no relationship to the informant is stated.

offence_category.reason: Offence is cheating under s.420 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Conviction is under Section 420 of the Penal Code.

weapon.reason: No weapon is involved in the cheating offence.

evidence_type.quote: From the prosecution case and the evidence of witnesses
evidence_type.reason: Judgment refers to witness evidence and prosecution case, never calling it circumstantial.

confession.reason: Judgment is silent on any confession; 'None' is asserted without support.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Appellant is a woman and had only a subsidiary role in the offence
mitigating_circumstances.quote: It also needs to be kept in mind that she is a woman.
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment expressly treats her gender and subsidiary role as mitigating, so 'None noted' is wrong.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted both and sentenced each to two years and Rs.2,000 fine.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Criminal revision rejected without modification of conviction or sentence (judgment dated November 28, 2011)
high_court_outcome.quote: revision [(Criminal Revision No.2576 of 2011) (O&M)] was similarly rejected by the High Court without any modification in the conviction or sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court did decide the revision and dismissed it; 'Not applicable' is contradicted.

final_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.420 IPC; Supreme Court reduced sentence to one year imprisonment, fine undisturbed
final_outcome.quote: We, accordingly, modify and reduce her sentence of imprisonment from two years to one year leaving the fine undisturbed.
final_outcome.reason: Conviction is right, but the omission of the Supreme Court's sentence reduction makes the outcome incomplete.

offence_finally_established.reason: Cheating under s.420 is the offence of conviction.

imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence is a fixed term of imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.reason: Sentence reduced to one year imprisonment.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs.2,000 is stated and left undisturbed.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts match the judgment and do not reveal the Supreme Court's sentence reduction.

offence_severity.quote: We, accordingly, modify and reduce her sentence of imprisonment from two years to one year
offence_severity.reason: Column is a severity rating; the value is a superseded trial sentence, not a severity classification.

attempt_completion.reason: Money was extracted and no employment provided, so the offence was completed.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence (cheating under s.420 IPC) committed by two accused
number_of_offences.quote: both appellant and her husband were convicted for the same offence
number_of_offences.reason: Judgment refers to one offence of cheating, not two offences or counts.

financial_property_loss.reason: Rs.70,000 extracted from informant is stated in the prosecution case.

motive.correct_value: Financial gain by extracting money through a false promise of a police job
motive.quote: extracted Rs.70,000/-from the informantAngrej Singh by making the false promise
motive.reason: Motive is evident from the money-for-job scheme, though not explicitly stated, so 'Not identified' is incomplete.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the prosecution case and the court's finding on relative roles.

witness_credibility.quote: From the prosecution case and the evidence of witnesses it is evident
witness_credibility.reason: Judgment does not assess witness credibility; it only relies on witness evidence.

trial_duration.reason: Dates of payment, trial judgment, High Court and Supreme Court decisions match the judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR No.22 registered June 2, 2004; trial completed
investigation_status.quote: arising out of FIR No.22 dated June 2, 2004
investigation_status.reason: FIR date is correct, but a charge sheet filing is not stated in the judgment.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: conviction and sentence; Additional Sessions Judge: appeal dismissed (Sept 30, 2011); High Court: revision rejected without modification; Supreme Court: appeal partly allowed
appeal_history.quote: Their appeal (Criminal Appeal No.75 of 14.10.2005) was dismissed by the judgment and order dated September 30, 2011 by the Additional Sessions Judge
appeal_history.reason: Omits the Additional Sessions Judge's dismissal of the appeal.

prosecution_argument.reason: Summary accurately reflects the prosecution case on payments and the unfulfilled job promise.

defence_argument.reason: Defence arguments are not recorded in the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Same offence does not mean same punishment; relative roles must be considered.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Hiralal Mallick v. State of Bihar, (1977) 4 SCC 44 is cited.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Subsidiary role, gender and one-year sentence match the court's reasoning.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Gender and subsidiary role are the mitigating factors the court relied on.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are identified by the court.

other_sentence_order.reason: No separate sentencing order beyond the reduction and undisturbed fine.
